newsitem.title: INDIA: Most Indian metals' prices rise on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Most Indian metals' prices rise on good demand.

text.p: Indian copper and zinc prices gained on Tuesday while other base metals were steady in a narrow price band, traders said. Copper and zinc rose on speculative cum physical buying coupled with restricted arrivals of the imported metal. Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,500 rupees while zinc rose 25 to 6,450 rupees. Sentiment was firm on expectation that state agencies may hike next month's selling price. Last week copper rose by 550 rupees and zinc by 50 rupees. Tin remained steady at 34,700 rupees and nickel at 36,800. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,300 rupees and lead at 4,600 rupees on nominal trading.
